_comment: Price assumptions for the cost model. Every number has a source and an access date (all accessed 23.10.2026). Hardware is priced at current US retail prices for the same configuration, not at what the team paid, because both machines were bought earlier at lower prices and the RQ is about a team deciding today.
electricity_source: Astana-REK tariff for legal entities from June 2026: 39.58 KZT/kWh (digitalbusiness.kz, 26.05.2026); households pay 20.21 to 36.36 KZT/kWh
attribution_comment: dedicated = the machine is bought for inference and its whole price is charged to it. shared_dev_machine = the machine already exists as a developer workstation and only a quarter of its price is charged to inference (team assumption, stated in the report as a scenario, not a measurement).

mac_m4pro.source: Apple list price of MacBook Pro 14-inch, M4 Pro (12-core CPU, 16-core GPU), 24 GB, 512 GB: USD 1,999 (AppleInsider price guide, snapshot 01.07.2026)
mac_m4pro.load_watts_source: powermetrics cpu_power+gpu_power during the main run, runs/mac_m4pro/power_main_*.txt

Gigabyte UD750GM 750 W Gold: typical Amazon price reported by slickdeals.net, Jan 2026

pc_rtx4060.source: Sum of current US prices of the team's build without monitor and peripherals; see components_usd
pc_rtx4060.load_watts_source: nvidia-smi power.draw (GPU only) plus 80 W assumed for the rest of the system under load

rented_rtx4090.source: RunPod Community Cloud RTX 4090 on-demand price USD 0.34/h (runpod.io/gpu-cloud/pricing, July 2026 page)
